bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
pg="$(docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -Ei 'postgres' || true)"
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$pg" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l)" -eq 1 || exit 61
where="(chat_id=-1002373696859 AND message_thread_id IN (4672,1)) OR (chat_id=-1003770334893 AND message_thread_id=1) OR (chat_id=-1003847210571 AND message_thread_id IN (105,1))"
printf 'NORMAL_MISSING_PINS_BEGIN\n'
docker exec "$pg" sh -c 'psql -X -q -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d gaybbs -At -F "|" -c "SELECT chat_id,message_thread_id,state,COALESCE(message_id,0),pinned FROM topic_dm_entry_pins WHERE (chat_id=-1002373696859 AND message_thread_id IN (4672,1)) OR (chat_id=-1003770334893 AND message_thread_id=1) OR (chat_id=-1003847210571 AND message_thread_id IN (105,1)) ORDER BY chat_id,message_thread_id;"'
printf 'NORMAL_MISSING_PINS_END\n'
printf 'NORMAL_MISSING_ROUTES_BEGIN\n'
docker exec "$pg" sh -c 'psql -X -q -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d gaybbs -At -F "|" -c "SELECT board_key,purpose,chat_id,message_thread_id,enabled,(verified_at IS NOT NULL) FROM posting_topics WHERE (chat_id=-1002373696859 AND message_thread_id IN (4672,1)) OR (chat_id=-1003770334893 AND message_thread_id=1) OR (chat_id=-1003847210571 AND message_thread_id IN (105,1)) ORDER BY chat_id,message_thread_id,purpose;"'
printf 'NORMAL_MISSING_ROUTES_END\n'
